mechanism_narrative: A sustained multi-week decline in WORKPLACES mobility removes the incidental retail trips tied to commuting (lunch breaks, after-work shopping), causing RETAIL_REC to remain depressed or fall further over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -39.6 to -63.3 over the snapshot window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last-28-day mean despite WORKPLACES remaining at or below -60 for the full next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week collapse in RETAIL_REC exceeding 30 points signals the onset of a policy-driven mobility restriction (e.g., non-essential retail closure order), which persists and keeps RETAIL_REC suppressed the following week.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC falls more than 30 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC dropped from -31.0 at t-1w to -64.9 at t-0w, a 33.9 point weekly fall
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rebounds (rises) in the week immediately following a >30-point weekly drop in more than half of observed instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL and decline in TRANSIT reflect a population-wide shift to sheltering-in-place behavior; these two reinforce each other to suppress discretionary retail trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 12.4 to 25.0 while TRANSIT fell from -39.9 to -49.9 across the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 2 weeks even though RESIDENTIAL stays above +20 and TRANSIT stays below -45 simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Under an active lockdown/state-of-alarm regime, mandated closures of non-essential retail and recreation venues create a structural floor well below pre-crisis baseline that does not mean-revert within four weeks, keeping RETAIL_REC deeply negative.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC and WORKPLACES both fall below -60 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC reached -64.9 and WORKPLACES reached -63.3 at t-0w, consistent with simultaneous closure of retail and offices
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC recovers toward pre-drop levels (above -40) within four weeks while the lockdown regime indicator (both series below -60) remains active.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility crosses below -40, it indicates enforcement of outdoor movement restrictions beyond normal distancing, which generalizes to broader activity suppression and further reduces RETAIL_REC over the subsequent two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -20.9 at t-1w to -50.4 at t-0w, crossing the -40 threshold
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks in more than half of cases where PARKS drops below -40.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, despite its essential and inelastic nature, signals high public compliance with stay-home behavioral norms; this same compliance drives continued suppression of non-essential RETAIL_REC in the immediate following week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from -8.3 to -24.1 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the week following a drop in GROCERY_PHARM, despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining below -20.

mechanism_narrative: Spring is normally a period of rising outdoor and retail activity in Madrid; when a lockdown regime overrides this seasonal uptick, the expected seasonal rebound in RETAIL_REC fails to materialize and the series stays suppressed for four weeks instead of climbing as seasonality would predict.
evidence_refs: fact:both RETAIL_REC and PARKS fell sharply at t-0w rather than showing a seasonal spring increase
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows a seasonal-style rebound (positive trend) over the next 4 weeks despite PARKS remaining suppressed below -40.

mechanism_narrative: Joint collapse of WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility indicates enforced restriction on both commuting and public transport use; together they eliminate the two main channels that feed retail footfall, compounding to push RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -63.3 and TRANSIT fell to -49.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 2 weeks even though both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below -45 simultaneously.
